summary.name: DiffusionBee
summary.one_liner: DiffusionBee is a free app for running Stable Diffusion AI image generation locally on your computer.
use_cases: Generate AI art from text prompts on your own computer
Add or remove objects in selected image regions
Train a custom image model on your own pictures
Create images with a specific structure using control images
summary.what_it_does:
DiffusionBee is a toolbox for running Stable Diffusion and other generative AI apps locally. It offers text-to-image generation, image-to-image transformation, generative fill for adding or removing objects in selected regions, and an image upscaler. It also provides image variant generation, control-image based generation, an illusion generator, and video/animation tools. Users can train custom image models on their own images, which the page says can be done locally in a few clicks. The page states that prompts, models and generated images stay on the user's device.</what_it_does>
<parameter name="pricing">free
